meta.cite: Barton O. Oliver's mTOR Atlas (live data, not an archived version; give corpus_snapshot and source_commit). doi:10.5281/zenodo.22059963

data.mechanism: Free eIF4E recruits the ribosome to the mRNA cap. This is the step that actually turns a growth signal into new protein.
data.mechanism_beginner: Freed eIF4E brings the ribosome to the mRNA – the step that actually turns a growth signal into new protein.
data.boundary: Biochemical and cell-based evidence (mouse cells with ribosome profiling, mouse models with human prostate cancer data in one study) plus a review. How much a given tissue depends on eIF4E-driven translation is not settled by these sources.
data.note: Not every mRNA is equally sensitive - HSI2012 shows a specific translational program, not a uniform increase.
